name: pulse
description: A market watchlist that behaves like an inbox

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start --workspace server" "npm run preview --workspace web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.reset: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('server/data',{recursive:true,force:true})" && echo "database cleared; it rebuilds on next start"
